title: Unevenness
summary: UNE'VENNESS, noun 1. Surface not level; inequality of surface; as the unevenness of ground or of roads. 2. Turbulence; change; want of uniformity; as the unevenness of king Edward's reign. [Unusual.]

inlines.v: UNE'VENNESS, noun 1. Surface not level; inequality of surface; as the unevenness of ground or of roads. 2. Turbulence; change; want of uniformity; as the unevenness of king Edward's reign. [Unusual.] 3. Want of uniformity; as unevenness of temper. 4. Want of smoothness.
